releaseNotes: PRVN Music v0.14.0 (Build 17): Complete Compose Multiplatform reimplementation based on official SimpMusic foundation; fixed GitHub in-app update checks & User-Agent filtering with raw manifest fallback; fixed Android 13+ system notification permissions & added dedicated App Updates notification channel; PRVN Dark (#0B0E14), Purple (#A855F7) and Cyan (#06B6D4) branding; robust Listen Together with MetroServer protocol and independent local stream resolution; Google Play Protect compliance.
